Martin Joughin’s October/Negotiations translation credit corroborated in Deleuze bibliography https://www.webdeleuze.com/textes/187 . Theories, historic periodization and economic claims remain Deleuze’s interpretations; complete monographs unread.

relations.relationship: Reworks Foucault’s account of disciplinary enclosures through a proposed transition toward continuously modulating control.
relations.evidence_note: Complete short primary essay transcription read, especially Historical section. Deleuze’s reading of Foucault and periodization remain attributed; no new independent collation of Foucault originals or claim that old institutions uniformly disappeared. A specific interpretive contribution, not inferred generic influence.

relations.relationship: Connects codes, information access and changing machines to forms of social control while explicitly resisting technological determinism.
relations.evidence_note: Primary Logic and Program sections: machines express social forms capable of making/using them; coding and access examples are a research programme. Historical economic generalizations and forecasts are not certified current descriptions or imported as universal facts.
